title: Paused model switch can be lost to a resume already in its gates
description: A paused switch (switchPausedRunModels CAS) that lands between a resume reading the paused point (ui/server.mjs resume route / cmdResume: readPipelineForResume -> createOrchestratorFor) and claimForResume is confirmed to the user ('Switched N stages') but the resume runs on the pre-switch manifest. Reachable with scheduled / usage-limit auto-resumes. Fix: token-guarded claimForResume (WHERE json_extract(resume_point,'$.pausedBy') IS ?, passing the read point's pausedBy) or re-read after the claim and refuse 'models were switched meanwhile — resume again' (row stays paused, retry safe). Found by the final review of PR #608; pre-existing since the original feature.
